title: Content & Marketing Manager
description:
**About Us**

PlusWealth Capital Management LLP is a proprietary high-frequency trading firm, active in multiple markets including equities, options, and futures, and a SEBI-registered portfolio manager (PMS) offering data-driven, systematic investment strategies to investors. We thrive on building cutting edge, data-driven, and tech-based trading algorithms. As a dynamic, machine-learning oriented trading platform, we embody the ethos of THINK. TECH. TRADE. If you share our vision, we'd love to have you onboard.

**Role Overview**

We are looking for a Content & Marketing Manager to own PlusWealth's marketing across paid campaigns, social media, content and investor events. At PlusWealth, data does the investing; we need someone to do the talking. The role will work closely with the Founders, Fund Managers, Sales and Compliance, and will be measured on the investors it brings in.

**Responsibilities**

● Plan, run and optimise Google, LinkedIn and Meta ad campaigns, including budgets, creatives and landing pages.

● Track every lead through to an investor conversation, and report cost per lead and conversions weekly.

● Manage and grow PlusWealth's presence on LinkedIn, X and YouTube.

● Write investor letters, market notes and strategy explainers.

● Run the newsletter, webinars and investor events.

● Work with Compliance to ensure all communication follows SEBI and APMI advertising rules.

● Try new formats, such as a podcast, a video series or something nobody has done before; if it's a good idea, you can make it happen.

**Qualifications**

● 2–5 years of experience in finance or fintech marketing.

● Hands-on experience running paid campaigns, with results you can show.

● Ability to write clearly and explain investing ideas in plain language.

● Ability to design in Canva or similar tools and publish independently.

● Comfort with numbers and using data to decide what to keep doing.

● Knowledge of SEBI/APMI advertising rules, or the ability to learn them quickly.

● Bachelor's degree in any discipline; MBA in Marketing is an advantage.

**Preferred Experience**

● Experience at a PMS, AIF, mutual fund, broker or wealth platform.

● Video editing or basic website skills.

● Experience building a brand or channel from the ground up.

**Benefits & Perks:**

● Competitive compensation and performance-based bonuses.

● Flat organizational structure with high ownership and visibility.

● Medical insurance – we've got you covered.

● Catered meals/snacks for 5 working days in the office.

● Generous paid time off policies.

● Other benefits like referral policy, team building activities and hampers/gift voucher.

**PlusWealth Capital Management is an equal opportunity employer**

title: Marketing Content Specialist
description:
Job Type: Full-time

Location: Hybrid/On-site

**The Opportunity**

Visdum is building the future of sales commission automation, and content plays a key role in how we tell that story. We’re looking for a motivated Content Marketing Specialist to join our growing Marketing team and help shape how finance and revenue leaders discover, understand, and trust Visdum.

This role is content-first. You’ll spend most of your time creating high-quality written content, while also learning how to distribute it effectively and engage the right audience across channels. You’ll have the freedom to experiment, take ownership, and grow alongside a fast-moving SaaS startup.

If you're someone who thrives on autonomy, keeps up with trends, and brings creativity to every project, we want to hear from you. Our ideal candidate is either starting out or has less than a year of B2B content writing experience (bonus points for SaaS experience), an eye for detail, and the ability to write crisply using simple language.

**Responsibilities:**

* This role will involve creating high-quality content for the brand - social media posts, blogs, case studies, eBooks, emails, whitepapers, video scripts, etc.
* Develop a good understanding of the “Sales Compensation” industry and the people involved in it to create compelling content to drive awareness and leads for Visdum.
* Have a strong understanding or have the aptitude to learn SEO and AEO best practices to make your content rank.
* Own and drive the social media calendar and strategy end-to-end. Come up with creative campaigns to improve Visdum’s engagement on LinkedIn.
* Over time, own and drive the on-page, off-page SEO, backlinks strategy, and execution.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to create sales enablement.
* Write PR stories or external announcements to elevate the Visdum brand.

**Requirements**

* Candidates with 0-3 years of B2B content writing experience (SaaS experience preferred).
* Experience in writing content (freelance/part-time will also be considered) for the US region is an added advantage.
* Basic design skills using Canva/Figma/Adobe Photoshop/Illustrator, etc.
* Exceptional writing skills, with a penchant for quality and attention to detail. We prefer simple language to jargon. Someone with a natural passion and a flair for storytelling and writing would fit in well.
* Understanding of SEO and AISO (Artificial Intelligence Search Optimization) to track content performance is preferred.
* Great research skills and the ability to obtain information from anywhere would be ideal.
* Understands the fundamental concepts of content distribution and audience engagement.
* A team player with strong multitasking skills and an eye for detail is mandatory.
* Being proactive and resourceful enough to be a team player. This is a strong part of our culture and applies to every role.
* The ability to own outcomes over inputs. It’s not about how much content you create, but about what outcome it helps us achieve.

**How we will set you up for success**

* We will provide you with detailed training to give you a head start in the world of content marketing. We'll thoroughly talk about the competitive landscape in the sales compensation industry, and provide you access to recorded conversations, and existing marketing material.
* You will have plenty of opportunities to be in touch with your audience by listening to calls with prospects and current customers every day.
* You will have a quarterly review with your manager to discuss career goals and overall success, along with regular mentoring.
* You will have a lot of creative freedom to experiment and try new things once you understand the goals and the audience well. We aren’t one of those organizations where ideas only come from the top – some of our best ideas have come from random brainstorming sessions, and we expect you to contribute great ideas.

**About Visdum**

Founded in 2020 by ex-Oracle Executives who have 50+ years of experience in the IT industry, Visdum was started with the goal to democratize sales commissions. The platform is designed to automate complex commission calculations for fast-growing mid-market and enterprise organizations, helping businesses save hundreds of hours every month and driving greater sales performance.

Visdum helps Finance, Revenue Operations, and Sales teams manage and optimize sales

incentive compensation process, giving real-time visibility to payouts and a decrease in calculation errors.

title: Affiliate Marketing Manager
description:
**Company Description**
Grow Money Capital Private Limited has been part of India’s financial services sector since 1995, operating as a non-deposit-taking NBFC registered with the Reserve Bank of India. The company offers a diverse range of lending solutions, including Micro Enterprise Loans, Loan Against Property, Vehicle and Electric Two-Wheeler Financing, Supply Chain Finance, and Corporate Lending. Through co-lending partnerships with NBFCs, MFIs, and fintech companies, Grow Money Capital extends credit access to underserved market segments. Its personal loan brand, Cashvia, provides retail borrowers with a fully digital, transparent, and responsible lending experience. The organization combines long-standing lending expertise with modern, technology-enabled delivery models to make credit more accessible while building strong partnerships across the financial ecosystem.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Affiliate Marketing & Customer Acquisition**

* Develop and execute affiliate marketing strategies to drive customer acquisition for digital lending products.
* Manage acquisition channels, including affiliates, DSAs, fintech partners, aggregators, and performance marketing platforms.
* Drive quality lead generation, loan applications, approvals, and disbursals while achieving CAC and ROI targets.
* Expand acquisition reach across Tier 1, Tier 2, and Tier 3 markets.

**2. Partnership Development & Management**

* Identify, onboard, and manage affiliate partners, digital aggregators, fintech platforms, and DSAs.
* Negotiate commercial terms, payout structures, and service-level agreements to ensure profitable partnerships.
* Build long-term partner relationships and continuously improve partner performance.
* Monitor partner productivity, lead quality, conversion rates, and overall business contribution.

**3. Campaign Management & Funnel Optimization**

* Plan, execute, and optimize affiliate campaigns to improve lead quality and conversion rates.
* Monitor key performance metrics, including CPL, CPA, CAC, approval rate, disbursal rate, rejection rate, and ROI.
* Analyze campaign performance and implement corrective actions to improve acquisition efficiency.
* Scale high-performing campaigns while maintaining acquisition cost and profitability targets.

**4. Business Growth & Revenue Generation**

* Drive loan application volumes, credit approvals, disbursals, and revenue growth through affiliate channels.
* Develop channel-wise growth plans aligned with business targets.
* Optimize the partner mix to improve portfolio quality and maximize business returns.
* Work towards achieving monthly and quarterly acquisition and disbursal targets.

**5. Cross-Functional Coordination**

* Collaborate with Credit, Risk, Product, Operations, and Technology teams to improve the customer acquisition funnel.
* Align partner acquisition strategies with credit policies, customer eligibility criteria, and risk parameters.
* Resolve funnel bottlenecks and improve application processing and disbursal turnaround time.

**6. Compliance & Risk Management**

* Ensure affiliate campaigns and partner activities comply with applicable RBI digital lending requirements, data protection obligations, and internal company policies.
* Monitor fraudulent traffic, duplicate applications, fake leads, mis-selling, and other partner-related risks.
* Establish partner due diligence, tracking, documentation, and payout validation processes.
* Coordinate with Compliance and Risk teams to address regulatory and operational concerns.

**7. Performance Reporting & Analytics**

* Prepare and review daily, weekly, and monthly MIS reports covering leads, applications, approvals, disbursals, CAC, ROI, and partner performance.
* Analyze channel-wise and partner-wise performance to identify growth opportunities and underperforming sources.
* Present performance reviews, business forecasts, and actionable recommendations to senior management.

**8. Budget & Commercial Management**

* Manage affiliate marketing budgets and partner payouts in line with approved business plans.
* Monitor acquisition costs, campaign profitability, and return on marketing investment.
* Ensure accurate partner invoicing, payout reconciliation, and commercial governance.

**9. Process Improvement & Automation**

* Establish standard operating procedures for partner onboarding, campaign tracking, lead attribution, and payout management.
* Implement tracking systems, dashboards, and automation to improve reporting accuracy and operational efficiency.
* Continuously improve affiliate marketing processes to support scalable and sustainable business growth.

title: National Head - Partner and Reseller Channel
description:
**Company Description**

Justdial Limited is India's leading local search and digital business discovery platform, founded in 1996 and headquartered in Mumbai. With a strong digital presence and an extensive business database, the company continues to help consumers find reliable local businesses while enabling enterprises to expand their reach through digital marketing and lead generation solutions. For more information about the company, you can visit the 'About Us' page of our website
www.justdial.com

**Role Description**

This leader builds JUST DIAL's commission-based partner network into a pay-on-success channel that sells JUST DIAL's full product range.

Title - National Head, Partner and Reseller Channel

Reports to - Chief Revenue Officer, JUST DIAL Core

Level - Senior leadership (VP / AVP equivalent)

Team - 4 zonal partner heads (N, S, E, W), partner onboarding and enablement, partner operations

Works closely with - Revenue Operations and Pricing, Sales Technology (partner app), field and inside sales heads

Roles and responsibilities

1.      
**Channel strategy and design**

* Define partner types and tiers: resellers (agencies, distributors), freelance agents, and referral partners such as CA firms, POS/billing vendors and trade associations.

2.      Set coverage by city and pin-code, prioritizing target towns

3.      
**Partner recruitment and onboarding**

* Grow the network to deliver AOP target
* Run partner selection, contracts, KYC and a 2–3 week onboarding (including Training) with certification.

4.      
**Productivity and enablement**

* Build training, pitch kits, demo scripts and lead-sharing so partners sell across the ladder, from JUST DIAL Verified core package.
* Run monthly partner reviews; weed out inactive partners each quarter.

5.      
**Commercials and governance**

* With Revenue Ops, own partner commission slabs, payout timelines and claw-backs on refunds or non-renewals.
* Enforce lead-ownership and pricing rules so partners never undercut or clash with the field force or tele-sales.

6.      
**Ladder progression**

* Raise partner AVPC by moving partners from entry products to core packages; agree with Revenue Ops which merchants partners own versus the field force so the two do not clash.

7.      
**Partner technology**

* Act as business owner of the partner app and portal (onboarding, lead logging, payouts, dashboards) with Sales Technology.

8.      
**Team leadership**

* Appoint and lead 11 Branch Partner heads plus enablement and operations teams.

9.      
**Reporting**

* Weekly channel dashboard to the CRO; quarterly business review on channel economics against field and telesales.

**Must have**

•        15–20 years in sales, with at least 5 years leading a national or multi-state indirect channel.

•        Built or scaled a partner, reseller, agent or distributor network of 1,000+ partners, selling to small businesses or retail customers.

•        Designed commission slabs, payout rules and clawbacks; understands channel unit economics and cost per acquisition.

•        Managed channel conflict between direct sales and partners.

•        Comfortable running the channel on data: CRM, partner dashboards, cohort and productivity analysis.

•        Led managers across zones; hired and built teams from a small base.

**Good to have**

•        Experience in tier 2–4 markets and with gig or freelance sales models.

•        Has launched a partner app or portal with a tech team.

•        Exposure to selling SaaS or digital subscriptions to SMBs, not only physical products.

•        MBA or equivalent; fluent Hindi and English, plus a regional language.

**Behaviours we are hiring for**

•        Builder mindset: comfortable with ambiguity and a small starting base.

•        High integrity, given the risk of mis-selling through third parties.

•        Partner-first: treats partners as a business to grow, not a cost line.

Location and travel

Based at JUST DIAL's head office in Noida, close to the CRO. Expect 40–50% travel to Branches and partner towns.

Please contact leena@justdial.com if you encounter any difficulties while submitting your application.

title: Associate Director - Product
description:
Technical Product Manager
  
  
**Location:**
Noida / Remote / Hybrid
  
  
**Department:**
Product & Technology
  
  
**Reports To:**
Chief Executive Officer (Product Strategist)
  
  
**Employment Type:**
Full-Time
  
  
**About The Role**
We are looking for a Technical Product Manager who can own a product end to end — from the first spark of an idea through design, development, and launch. This is a hands-on role for someone who thinks like a designer, understands code and system architecture, and can turn ambiguous problems into shipped products.
  
  
This role is unique in two ways. First, product direction comes from our CEO acting as Product Strategist: you will operate with a strong Business Analyst mindset, eliciting requirements from strategic conversations and turning high-level vision into precise, buildable specifications. You will do the same with very non-technical stakeholders — including the CFO and other executives — converting business and financial needs into clear product requirements. Second, we run a Rapid Development Framework with sprints executed in 2-day cycles, so speed of translation from idea to working prototype to shipped increment is the core skill of this job.
  
  
What You’ll Do
  
  

* Requirements from the Product Strategist — Work directly with the CEO/Product Strategist to capture product vision and strategy; run structured elicitation sessions, ask the questions that surface hidden requirements, and translate strategic intent into PRDs, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
* Business analysis with non-technical stakeholders — Elicit and document requirements from non-technical executives such as the CFO — interviewing, workshopping, and process-mapping to convert business, financial, and operational needs into unambiguous specifications developers can build from.
* Rapid prototyping & sign-off — Build rapid prototypes (wireframes, clickable mockups, working demos in tools like Figma or lightweight code) within hours or days, walk stakeholders through them, incorporate feedback in fast iteration loops, and drive to formal sign-off before development begins.
* 2-day sprint cycles — Operate our Rapid Development Framework: plan, scope, and close sprints on 2-day cycles; break features into increments buildable within a cycle; run tight stand-ups; and keep a continuously groomed, developer-ready backlog.
* Developer collaboration — Collaborate daily with engineers to scope feasibility, make speed/quality/scope trade-offs in real time, unblock development, and coordinate QA and launch readiness in a fast-paced environment.
* Roadmap & metrics — Own the roadmap for your product area, prioritizing by customer impact, business value, and technical effort; define and track post-launch metrics and use data to drive the next iterations.
* Communication — Communicate progress, decisions, and trade-offs clearly to leadership and cross-functional stakeholders, adapting your style for engineers, designers, executives, and customers.

What We’re Looking For
  
  

* Experience owning products end to end — concept through design, development, and post-launch iteration — not just managing a backlog.
* Strong Business Analyst skillset: proven ability to elicit requirements from senior, strategy-level stakeholders (CEO/founder level) and from non-technical executives (CFO, operations leaders), and to document them as clear PRDs, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
* Demonstrated rapid prototyping ability — wireframing, prototyping, and using tools such as Figma — with a track record of getting stakeholder sign-off quickly and using prototypes to de-risk development.
* Experience in accelerated or rapid development environments (short sprint cycles, RAD, or continuous delivery); comfort planning and shipping in 2-day sprint cycles.
* Solid technical foundation: comfortable reading code, understanding APIs and system architecture, and having informed technical conversations with engineers without necessarily writing production code.
* Strong product thinking — able to break vague problems into structured, testable hypotheses and make sound trade-off decisions under time pressure.
* Comfort using data to decide: defining metrics, analyzing funnels, and running experiments such as A/B tests.
* Thrives in a fast-paced, high-ownership environment with shifting priorities and direct executive visibility.
* Typically 7 to 12 years in product management and business analysis, with prior experience in software engineering, design, or a technical role a strong plus.

Nice to Have
  
  

* Experience with SaaS or B2B products; prior startup or early-stage experience where you wore multiple hats.
* Familiarity with SQL or basic scripting for pulling and analyzing your own data.
* Exposure to design systems and component libraries.
* Experience working directly with founders or C-suite as the primary source of product direction.

title: Category Manager

As a Category Manager, you will be responsible for driving the strategic sourcing and commercial management of third-party software and associated services within Nokia's Software & Data Server Hardware category. You will play a key role in delivering business value while ensuring compliance, governance, and sustainable sourcing practices across the supplier ecosystem.

* Develop and execute category strategies, sourcing roadmaps, and supplier portfolio plans aligned with business objectives and market dynamics.
* Lead end-to-end sourcing activities, including RFx processes, supplier identification, evaluation, selection, and onboarding in accordance with Nokia sourcing policies.
* Negotiate commercial agreements, licensing models, pricing structures, and contractual terms to maximize value and mitigate business risks.
* Drive cost competitiveness through market intelligence, cost analysis, benchmarking, and total cost of ownership (TCO) optimization.
* Manage strategic supplier relationships, monitor performance, and implement continuous improvement and corrective action plans where required.
* Optimize the utilization of preferred suppliers by balancing cost, quality, innovation, service levels, delivery capabilities, and business requirements.
* Build strong partnerships with internal stakeholders, ensuring sourcing decisions support customer commitments, business priorities, and operational requirements.
* Contribute to the enhancement of sourcing processes, tools, governance frameworks, and best practices to improve efficiency and procurement effectiveness.

Must Have:
  
  

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Supply Chain, Procurement, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related discipline.

* Experience in software sourcing, software licensing models, SaaS, cloud services, or related commercial frameworks.
* Proven stakeholder management, communication, and influencing skills with the ability to collaborate across global and cross-functional teams.
* Proven analytical capabilities with experience in cost modeling, pricing analysis, supplier evaluation, and negotiation planning.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a dynamic environment while maintaining a strong focus on compliance, governance, and business outcomes.
* Familiar with supplier relationship management (SRM), procurement best practices, and category management methodologies.
* Experience working in a global matrix organization with exposure to cross-cultural stakeholder and supplier management.

Nice to Have:
  
  

* Familiarity with procurement platforms, Microsoft Office tools, data analytics, and AI-enabled sourcing solutions.

title: Senior Executive: Influencer Marketing
description:
About Effora

Effora is building a beauty and wellness brand across devices, topicals and supplements for Indian consumers. We grow through creators, and we measure every creator by what they sell.

About the Role

You will run creator campaigns that are judged on revenue, not just reach. You’ll find creators, negotiate performance-linked deals, manage execution, and report what worked in sales, CAC and ROAS. We want someone who is comfortable with spreadsheets, quick to negotiate and clear about which creators make money.

Key Responsibilities

**Creator Sourcing & Negotiation**

* Identify and onboard creators on Instagram and YouTube based on audience fit, engagement quality and sales potential.
* Negotiate performance-linked deals: affiliate commissions, discount codes, trackable links, and fixed plus variable pay.
* Build repeat partnerships with creators who deliver, and drop those who don’t.

**Campaign Execution**

* Run campaigns end to end: briefing, product dispatch, content approvals, posting schedules and deliverables.
* Keep content on brand and compliant. No unverified claims on devices or supplements.
* Coordinate with creators, agencies and talent managers, and resolve issues quickly.

**Affiliate & Performance Growth**

* Build and manage the creator affiliate programme with unique links and codes.
* Track creator-level clicks, conversions, orders, AOV and attributable revenue.
* Shift budget toward creators with the best return and pause underperformers.

**Reporting & Analysis**

* Report on reach, engagement, CPV, CTR, conversions, CAC and ROAS for each creator and campaign.
* Maintain a creator database with performance history and rates.
* Turn results into clear recommendations on who to scale, renew or cut.

**Content Amplification**

* Work with the Growth team to test top-performing creator content in paid ads.
* Secure usage rights and organise creator assets for social and e-commerce use.

**Budget & Operations**

* Track budgets, invoices and payments, and deliver within approved spend.
* Monitor creator and competitor trends, and suggest new formats and platforms.

Requirements

* 3–4 years of experience in influencer marketing, creator partnerships or affiliate marketing.
* Hands-on experience running creator campaigns for D2C beauty, wellness or consumer brands.
* Strong negotiation skills, especially on performance-based deals.
* Good command of Excel or Google Sheets and campaign reporting.
* Understanding of Instagram and YouTube, and how creators drive purchases.
* Able to manage several campaigns at once and meet deadlines.
* Based in or able to commute to Noida.

Good to Have

* Experience with affiliate tracking tools, discount codes and UTM-based attribution.
* Experience turning creator content into paid ads.
* An existing network of beauty and wellness creators.
* Experience on both the agency or platform side and the in-house brand side.

Why Effora?

* Work closely with the Founder and Growth team.
* Build and own a performance creator programme across beauty and wellness.
* Direct impact on brand demand and revenue.

**Working Conditions**

* Office-based role in Noida.
* Full-time position, Monday to Friday (Saturdays WFH)

**Why Join Us?**

* Be part of India’s fastest-growing D2C brand in wellness
* Work in a dynamic, fast-paced environment with a young, passionate team
* Ownership & growth opportunities
* Competitive salary + perks in a high-impact role
* Shape the future of innovative health & wellness products

How to Apply

* Share your CV and the campaigns you personally managed, with your role, budget range, results and learnings, at
  **talent@effora.in**

description:
**Digital Marketing Lead**

*In-house | Full-time | Hybrid On-site – Noida)*

A bridal lehenga is rarely bought on impulse. It’s bought after months of searching, saving, comparing and dreaming. We’re looking for the person who knows how to be there at every one of those moments, and can prove it with numbers.

**Lehenga Lovestory**
is an ethnic fashion house with bridal at its heart. Our pieces are hand-embroidered, made to order, and built on craftsmanship, emotion and thoughtful detail. We dress every woman at the celebration: the bride, her mother, her sisters and her closest friends.

We’re hiring a Digital Marketing Lead to own how the brand finds, wins and keeps its customers online.

This is a senior, hands-on role. You’ll own digital marketing end to end: you’ll set the strategy, plan it, run it, measure it and report on it. Managing agency partners is also part of this role.

**Your Role**

You’ll own the brand’s digital growth from first click to a design session with our concierge. That covers paid media, the website, search, and email and WhatsApp journeys. You’ll work closely with the founders, the social media team and the film team, turning the brand’s stories and creative into campaigns that perform. Every month, you’ll come back with clear evidence of what worked, what didn’t, and what we do next.

**What You’ll Work On**

* Set the digital marketing strategy, with clear targets for reach, enquiries, design sessions and revenue
* Plan campaigns around India’s wedding calendar, from peak seasons and festive windows to the quiet months in between
* Run paid campaigns on Meta and Google end to end: audiences, creative testing, bidding and budget allocation
* Own website performance on Shopify: landing pages, conversion paths, site speed and A/B tests
* Drive organic search: SEO strategy, content priorities, local search and Google Business Profile
* Design email and WhatsApp journeys that nurture a high-consideration customer over weeks, not days
* Brief the social media and film teams on the creative each campaign needs, and tell them what performed
* Set up and maintain tracking across GA4, Meta Pixel and Conversions API, so every rupee spent can be traced to an outcome
* Build dashboards and report to the founders every month: what moved, why it moved, and the next bet
* Manage agency and freelance partners where needed, holding them to clear briefs and outcomes

**Skills & Tools**

* 7–10 years in digital marketing, including at least 4 years owning strategy, performance and budgets yourself
* Experience in fashion, lifestyle, jewellery or luxury D2C brands is highly preferred
* Expert in digital campaign management, with deep hands-on experience in Meta Ads Manager and Google Ads
* Strong in analytics and reporting: fluent in GA4, Shopify analytics and dashboard tools such as Aplitude, Mixpanel or CleverTap, and able to turn data into a clear story
* Strong command of attribution, funnel metrics, CAC, ROAS and LTV
* Familiar with email and WhatsApp marketing platforms
* A portfolio or case studies showing campaigns you led, with outcomes
* Communication is a no-compromise: English and Hindi, verbal and written

**What You’ll Gain**

* Full ownership of digital growth at a fashion house built on real craft
* A direct line to the founders, with decisions made in days, not quarters
* A brand worth marketing: India's first digital-native ethnic fashion house
* Room to grow with the brand, including leading a team as it scales

Illustratively:o AWS — AWS Partner Network tiers and competencies, Migration Acceleration Program (MAP), Partner Opportunity Acceleration funding, MDF, ISV Accelerate, Marketplace listings and private offers, SMB/Digital Native segment motions.o Microsoft — Microsoft AI Cloud Partner Program, Solutions Partner designations, Azure Migrate & Modernize and Innovate & Modernize (AMM/AIM), ECIF, co-sell and IP co-sell ready status, Marketplace and multiparty private offers, the SMC-Corporate and SMB segment structure, CSP motions.o Google Cloud — Partner Advantage, delivery and expertise designations, partner incentives and funding, Marketplace, and Corporate/SMB segment engagement models.•Secure and deploy partner funding, MDF and incentives to seed mid-market demand generation and proof-of-concept work; own the utilisation and reporting of that funding.•Ensure we hold and maintain the certifications, competencies and designations that unlock segment-specific incentives and field preference.•Get our offerings listed, transactable and discoverable in the relevant marketplaces, and drive marketplace as a route to market for mid-market deals.Make joint selling work in practice•Create the operating rhythm: joint pipeline reviews, QBRs, territory-level cadence with hyperscaler mid-market sales managers, and escalation paths that work.•Enable both sides — train our sales teams on hyperscaler programs and co-sell mechanics; train hyperscaler sellers on what we do and why we're the right partner for a mid-market customer.•Drive joint demand generation with marketing: campaigns, workshops, assessments, industry events, and co-branded assets aimed at mid-market buyers.•Work opportunities through to close alongside our sales teams, bringing the hyperscaler in at the right moment with the right funding and the right sponsor.•Keep the data honest: accurate opportunity registration and tagging in partner portals (Partner Central, Partner Center, Partner Advantage) and clean reporting back into the business.Operate inside the alliance structure•Partner closely with the existing hyperscaler relationship heads and their teams — you are an extension of that team with a segment mandate, not a parallel track.•Feed mid-market insight, friction and asks upward into the global and India-level alliance conversations so segment needs are represented in annual planning and commitments.•Represent us credibly with hyperscaler leadership in India on everything concerning the mid-market segment.Required qualifications12+ years of total experience, with a substantial portion in cloud alliances, partner management, channel, or cloud-focused business development.•Direct, hands-on experience managing one or more hyperscaler relationships (AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud) from within a GSI, SI, consulting firm or large services organisation — you understand the GSI side of the table, not just the vendor side.•Demonstrated understanding of how hyperscalers organise, segment and incentivise their partner ecosystem, including the structural differences between Enterprise and mid-market/SMB/SMC motions.•Practical, working knowledge of hyperscaler partner programs, funding mechanisms, competencies and co-sell processes — including having personally secured and deployed partner funding.•A track record of driving measurable revenue or pipeline outcomes through a partnership, not only managing the relationship. You should be able to talk through specific numbers you were accountable for.•Experience selling or enabling the sale of services (migration, modernisation, data, AI, managed services) on a hyperscaler platform.•Strong existing network within at least one hyperscaler's India organisation.•Experience working with mid-market or SMB customers, or with the sales motions that serve them.•Bachelor's degree; MBA or equivalent preferred.Preferred qualifications•Relationships spanning more than one hyperscaler•Hyperscaler certifications (AWS Cloud Practitioner / Solutions Architect Associate, Microsoft AZ-900 or above, Google Cloud Digital Leader or equivalent).•Experience with cloud marketplaces as a transaction channel, including private offers and multiparty private offers.•Prior experience standing up a new segment, region or motion inside an existing partnership.•Familiarity with partner operations tooling and CRM hygiene at scale.•Exposure to hyperscaler fiscal-year planning and commitment-setting processes.

title: Director of Marketing & Growth
description:
**Location:**
Noida, Uttar Pradesh (Onsite)

**Experience:**
10+ Years

**Primary Market:**
North America / US, with expanding global responsibility

**Customer Segments:**
Pro-AV System Integrators, AV/IT Consultants, Enterprise AV Teams, Technology Managers and Commercial Technology Providers.

**Role Overview**

XTEN-AV is transforming the Pro-AV industry with an AI-powered platform for AV design, proposals, project management and workflow automation.

We are looking for a
**Director of Marketing & Growth**
to join our leadership team at our Noida headquarters. This is not a role focused primarily on managing day-to-day marketing activities.
**Your primary mandate is growth.**
We are looking for someone who can continuously answer the questions that matter most to our business:

**Where will our next phase of growth come from? Why are we winning or losing customers? Which markets, customer segments, channels and messages represent the biggest opportunities? What should we do differently to grow faster?**

You will analyze markets, customers, competitors, channels, positioning, product adoption and the customer journey to uncover growth opportunities. You will develop hypotheses, test new approaches, challenge existing assumptions and turn successful ideas into scalable growth strategies.

You will work closely with our founders and across Marketing, Sales, Product and Customer Success to translate insights into measurable business growth.

The ideal candidate combines
**B2B SaaS marketing expertise with exceptional strategic thinking, commercial judgment, creativity and a strong bias toward experimentation.**

**Key Responsibilities**

i- Growth Strategy & Opportunity Identification

ii- Continuously identify and prioritize new growth opportunities across customer segments, geographies, products, pricing, partnerships, channels and the customer lifecycle.

iii- Evaluate the size and potential of opportunities, develop hypotheses and build strategies for capturing them.

Think beyond existing marketing programs and continuously ask
**where XTEN-AV's next significant source of growth can come from.**

**Strategic Problem Solving**

i- Diagnose growth challenges using customer behavior, funnel data, market intelligence, competitive analysis and first-principles thinking.

ii- Go beyond identifying
**what happened**
to understand
**why it happened and what we should do about it.**

iii- Challenge assumptions and existing marketing playbooks when the data or market suggests a better approach.

**Growth Experimentation**

i- Build a disciplined experimentation framework across messaging, acquisition, conversion, onboarding, activation, adoption, retention and expansion.

ii- Develop hypotheses, define success metrics, run experiments quickly and turn successful experiments into scalable growth programs.

iii- Create an environment where the marketing organization continuously learns rather than simply executes.

iv- Full-Funnel Growth

v- Think beyond lead generation.

vi- Identify opportunities across the entire customer journey:

**Awareness → Acquisition → Conversion → Activation → Adoption → Retention → Expansion**

Work closely with Sales, Product and Customer Success to identify friction, improve conversion and increase customer lifetime value.

**Positioning & Category Strategy**

i- Define how XTEN-AV and its products should be positioned within the rapidly evolving intersection of
**AI, Pro-AV design and workflow automation.**

ii- Develop differentiated narratives that clearly communicate why customers should choose XTEN-AV over existing software, manual workflows or emerging competitors.

iii-Translate sophisticated capabilities—including AI-assisted AV design, automated schematics, BOM creation, CAD workflows and project automation—into compelling business outcomes and ROI stories.

**Market & Customer Intelligence**

Develop a deep understanding of our customers, including Pro-AV integrators, consultants, enterprise technology teams and AV professionals.

**Continuously analyze:**

* Customer needs and behavior
* Market trends
* Competitive positioning
* Win/loss patterns
* Product adoption
* Pricing and packaging
* Emerging technologies
* New customer segments and geographic opportunities

-Turn market intelligence into actionable growth strategies.

-Demand & Pipeline Strategy

-Determine the right combination of
**ABM, inbound, content, paid acquisition, events, partnerships, community, outbound support and other channels**
based on customer segment and economics.

-Build scalable programs that generate qualified pipeline and measurable ARR.

-Rather than simply operating existing channels, continuously evaluate
**where marketing resources should be invested for the highest incremental return.**

**Creative & Messaging Strategy**

i- Develop creative approaches for communicating complex technology simply and memorably.

ii- Challenge conventional B2B SaaS marketing and develop campaigns, narratives and creative concepts capable of standing out in the Pro-AV and technology markets.

iii- Ensure that messaging resonates differently when communicating with technical users, business leaders, enterprise buyers and industry partners.

**Growth Economics & Analytics**

Establish the metrics that matter most for growth and use them to guide business and marketing decisions.

Maintain a strong understanding of:

* CAC and LTV
* Customer acquisition by channel
* Funnel conversion
* Activation and product adoption
* Retention and churn
* Expansion revenue
* Pipeline velocity
* Marketing-attributed ARR
* Channel economics and ROI

The expectation is not simply to
**report numbers**
but to use those numbers to determine
**what the company should do next.**

**Marketing Leadership**

i- Lead, mentor and develop our marketing team across growth, demand generation, product marketing, content, creative and performance marketing.

ii- Establish clear priorities and empower functional team members to handle execution while maintaining strategic ownership of the overall marketing and growth direction.

iii- Build a culture of
**curiosity, experimentation, accountability and continuous improvement.**

**What We're Looking For**

i- Exceptional Strategic & Critical Thinking

ii- You can look at a complex business problem, separate symptoms from root causes, identify opportunities others may have overlooked and develop an actionable strategy.

iii- You are comfortable challenging assumptions—including your own.

**Proven Growth Track Record**

You have personally contributed to meaningful growth at a B2B technology or SaaS company and can clearly explain:

**What the situation was → what you discovered → what you changed → why you changed it → what happened as a result.**

**Senior B2B SaaS / Technology Experience**

i- 10+ years of experience in B2B marketing, growth, product marketing or related disciplines, including significant experience in senior leadership roles.

ii- Experience selling software or technology to professional, mid-market or enterprise customers is strongly preferred.

**Commercial Mindset**

i- You understand that marketing exists to create business outcomes.

ii- You are comfortable discussing revenue, ARR, pipeline, pricing, customer acquisition economics, retention and market opportunity—not simply campaigns, impressions and leads.

iii- Strong Product Marketing Foundation

iv- You can take a sophisticated technical product and make its value understandable and compelling to different audiences.

v- Experience marketing engineering software, workflow platforms, AI products, design tools or other technically complex B2B products is highly valuable.

**Experimentation Mindset**

i- You naturally turn questions into hypotheses and hypotheses into experiments.

ii- You are comfortable testing ideas, learning from unsuccessful experiments and changing direction when evidence contradicts your assumptions.

**Data Fluency**

i- You are comfortable working with marketing, product and revenue data and can independently derive insights from it.

ii- Experience with platforms such as HubSpot, Salesforce, Google Analytics, Mixpanel or equivalent systems is valuable, but
**strategic interpretation of data matters more than mastery of any particular tool.**

**Creativity & Intellectual Curiosity**

i- You actively study customers, markets, competitors, technology and human behavior.

ii- You bring original ideas rather than simply repeating established B2B marketing playbooks.

**Leadership**

You can set direction, communicate clearly and raise the quality of thinking across a team without needing to personally manage every activity.

**On-Site Presence**

This is a leadership position based at our
**Noida office**
and requires full-time in-office presence.

**What Success Looks Like**

Success in this position will not be measured by how many campaigns the marketing team launches.

We will measure success by whether you:

* Identify meaningful new sources of growth.
* Improve the economics and effectiveness of customer acquisition.
* Increase qualified pipeline and marketing-influenced ARR.
* Improve conversion throughout the customer journey.
* Strengthen XTEN-AV's positioning and differentiation.
* Develop successful growth experiments and scale the winners.
* Improve our understanding of customers, competitors and markets.
* Help leadership make better growth decisions.
* Build a marketing organization that thinks strategically rather than simply executes tasks.

**What We Offer**

**Strategic Influence:**
A seat at the leadership table with direct involvement in company growth strategy.

**Global Opportunity:**
Build the growth engine for an AI technology company serving customers across North America and international markets.

**Ownership:**
Significant autonomy to challenge existing approaches, test new ideas and influence where the company invests.

**Competitive Compensation:**
Industry-leading compensation, performance incentives and company stock options.

**High-Growth Environment:**
A fast-moving technology environment where strong ideas can quickly turn into company-wide initiatives.

**ROLE SUMMARY**

You will own end-to-end SEO for Proeffico's corporate site and product websites — technical SEO, on-page optimisation, content strategy and off-page authority building. The goal is simple: rank for high-intent commercial keywords in India and the GCC, and convert that traffic into qualified inbound pipeline for our sales team.

1. **Search Strategy —**
   Own keyword research, search intent mapping and content gap analysis across all Proeffico web properties, with separate strategies for Indian and GCC search markets.
2. **Technical SEO —**
   Audit and fix crawlability, indexation, site architecture, schema markup, Core Web Vitals, page speed, canonicalisation, redirects and mobile usability. Coordinate fixes with the engineering team.
3. **On-Page SEO —**
   Optimise titles, meta descriptions, headings, internal linking, URL structures, image alt text and landing page copy for target keywords and conversion.
4. **Content & Editorial —**
   Build the content calendar with the marketing and product teams. Brief and edit blogs, case studies, comparison pages, landing pages and product content for search visibility.
5. **Off-Page & Authority —**
   Execute white-hat link building, digital PR, directory and marketplace listings, guest posting and partner backlinks. Improve domain authority sustainably.
6. **Local & Geo SEO —**
   Manage Google Business Profile, local citations and geo-targeted landing pages for Noida/Delhi NCR and GCC city-level searches.
7. **Analytics & Reporting —**
   Track rankings, organic sessions, impressions, CTR, conversions and assisted pipeline. Build monthly dashboards and report insights, not just numbers.
8. **Competitive Intelligence —**
   Benchmark competitors in AI video analytics, ERP, CRM and POS categories. Identify keywords and content assets we can win.
9. **Cross-Functional —**
   Work with the paid, social and sales teams so SEO content supports campaigns, and use search data to inform positioning and messaging.

**REQUIRED SKILLS & EXPERIENCE**

1. 2–4 years of hands-on SEO experience, preferably in B2B SaaS, IT services or technology products.
2. Strong command of Google Search Console, Google Analytics 4, Google Tag Manager and at least one SEO suite (Ahrefs, SEMrush, Moz or Screaming Frog).
3. Working knowledge of HTML, CSS and structured data (JSON-LD schema); comfortable reading a page's source and briefing developers precisely.
4. Proven track record of improving organic rankings and traffic — able to show before/after data from previous roles.
5. Solid content sense: can write or edit a technical blog, product page or case study that reads well and ranks.
6. Understanding of B2B buyer journeys and how organic traffic converts into MQLs and SQLs.
7. Excellent written English and the ability to work independently with minimal supervision.

**GOOD TO HAVE**

1. Experience marketing to GCC / Middle East audiences, including multilingual or Arabic-language SEO.
2. Familiarity with WordPress, Webflow or headless CMS platforms.
3. Exposure to AI-assisted content workflows, programmatic SEO or GEO/AEO (optimising for AI search and answer engines).
4. Basic experience with paid search, LinkedIn campaigns or marketing automation tools.
5. Google Analytics or HubSpot certifications.

**WHAT WE OFFER**

1. Direct ownership of the organic channel for a fast-growing AI product company — your work is visible to leadership from day one.
2. Exposure to multiple product categories (AI video analytics, ERP, CRM, POS) and two geographies (India and GCC).
3. A collaborative, low-bureaucracy team with real budget for tools and experiments.
4. Competitive compensation aligned to experience and demonstrated impact.

title: Brand Manager
description:
Carnal | Full-Time | On-site 

**Role Overview**

We're looking for a Brand Manager who can build and grow brands through strategic thinking, consumer understanding, and impactful marketing. You'll be responsible for developing brand strategies, driving integrated marketing campaigns, and ensuring every consumer touchpoint is consistent, meaningful, and aligned with business objectives.

You'll work closely with strategy, creative, media, influencer, and client teams to bring brand ideas to life and deliver campaigns that create measurable business impact.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Own and manage brand strategy for assigned clients.
* Develop annual, quarterly, and campaign-level marketing plans aligned with business objectives.
* Translate consumer insights and market trends into actionable marketing initiatives.
* Create clear campaign briefs for creative, content, influencer, and digital teams.
* Ensure consistency across all brand touchpoints and communication.
* Work closely with internal teams to execute integrated 360° campaigns.
* Analyze campaign performance and recommend optimization opportunities.
* Monitor competitor activities, category trends, and emerging consumer behavior.
* Participate in client meetings and confidently present strategic recommendations.
* Collaborate with research, analytics, and media teams to measure brand performance.
* Manage campaign timelines while ensuring high-quality execution.

**Qualifications**

* 3-6 years of experience in Brand Marketing, Brand Management, Marketing, or Category Management.
* Prior experience in FMCG, consumer brands, D2C, or a brand-focused agency is highly preferred.
* Strong understanding of consumer behavior, market research, and brand positioning.
* Experience working on integrated marketing campaigns across digital, social, influencer, and offline channels.
* Ability to convert business objectives into actionable marketing strategies.
* Excellent stakeholder management and presentation skills.
* Strong analytical mindset with comfort working with campaign performance data.
* Proactive, detail-oriented, and highly collaborative.

**Bonus Points**

* Experience managing influencer-led or digital-first campaigns.
* Familiarity with AI-powered marketing tools and consumer intelligence platforms.
* Exposure to media planning, brand health tracking, or innovation launches.

title: Head of Product Marketing
description:
**About RateGain**

RateGain Travel Technologies Limited is a global provider of AI-powered SaaS solutions for travel and hospitality, working with 13,000+ customers and 700+ partners across 160+ countries. RateGain helps travel and hospitality businesses accelerate revenue generation through acquisition, retention, and wallet share expansion.

Today, RateGain is one of the world’s largest processors of electronic transactions, price points, and travel intent data, enabling revenue management, distribution, and marketing teams across hotels, airlines, metasearch companies, package providers, car rentals, travel management companies, cruises, and ferries to drive better business outcomes.

Founded in 2004 and headquartered in India, RateGain works with 33 of the Top 40 Hotel Chains, 4 of the Top 5 Airlines, 7 of the Top 10 Car Rental companies, and leading Destination Marketing Organizations, Online Travel Agents, and metasearch platforms, including 25 Global Fortune 500 companies, unlocking new revenue every day.

Recognized globally for its innovation and impact, RateGain has been named Best Digital Marketing Agency by HotelTechReport Awards and Best Channel Manager by the World Travel Tech Awards. In 2025, RateGain was honored as Emerging Company of the Year at The Economic Times Awards for Corporate Excellence, named among Deloitte India Technology Fast 50 for the sixth time, and won Excellence in Best AI Solution Showcase for UNO VIVA at the CII National AI Awards 2025.

**The Mission**

RateGain has built a broad portfolio of technology products serving the global travel and hospitality ecosystem. As we continue to scale across businesses, products, customer segments, and geographies, the opportunity now is to bring these capabilities together into a clear, differentiated, and compelling story for the market while ensuring each business and product has the positioning and go-to-market strategy it needs to win.

The Head of Product Marketing will build and lead Product Marketing across RateGain’s global portfolio, defining how customers and the market understand what we build, why it matter, and why RateGain wins.

Sitting at the intersection of Product, Marketing, Sales, Strategy, and the customer, this leader will translate complex technology into compelling customer value, bring customer and competitive insight into Product and commercial decisions, and build a Product Marketing organization that can operate strategically across multiple businesses while staying close to execution.

The mandate is not simply to market a collection of products. It is to shape the story of RateGain as a whole, strengthen the positioning of our businesses and products, and help define the categories and markets in which we choose to lead.

**Key Responsibilities:**

Product Marketing Strategy & Portfolio Positioning

* Define and own the Product Marketing strategy across RateGain’s businesses and product portfolio.
* Build a clear overarching narrative while ensuring each product and business line has differentiated positioning and value propositions.
* Translate complex product capabilities and technical differentiation into clear customer outcomes.
* Develop differentiated messaging across customer segments, use cases, products, markets, and buying audiences.
* Bring customer, market and competitive intelligence into Product and commercial strategy.
* Establish a consistent Product Marketing discipline across the organization, from strategy through execution.

**Portfolio, Market & Category Leadership**

* Develop a deep understanding of the markets, customers and competitive environments across RateGain’s different businesses and product lines.
* Identify the customer problems and market opportunities that matter most across the portfolio.
* Build differentiated positioning against established and emerging competitors.
* Identify opportunities to create and shape new market narratives rather than simply respond to existing categories.
* Ensure RateGain has a compelling and connected story across its broader portfolio while retaining the differentiation of individual products and businesses.

**Product Launch & GTM Excellence**

* Build a scalable and repeatable GTM framework across multiple businesses and product lines.
* Lead the Product Marketing contribution to major product, platform and portfolio launches.
* Drive positioning, messaging, customer and market validation, sales enablement, customer storytelling and advocacy.
* Partner with business and commercial teams to drive product adoption and growth.
* Establish post-launch adoption and lifecycle strategies and continuously improve the GTM playbook based on results.

**Product, Customer & Market Alignment**

* Act as the strategic bridge between what RateGain builds and what customers and markets need.
* Bring an outside-in customer and competitive perspective into Product decisions.
* Partner with Product leadership across businesses to influence roadmap priorities based on customer needs, market opportunity, and competitive dynamics.
* Connect insights across different products and businesses to identify broader portfolio opportunities.
* Strengthen alignment across Product, Engineering, Sales, Customer Success, Strategy and Marketing.

**Product Marketing Organization & Leadership**

* Lead and develop a team of approximately 12 Product Marketing professionals supporting RateGain’s portfolio.
* Define the Product Marketing operating model, priorities, roles, and accountability across businesses.
* Build strong Product Marketing capabilities and develop future leaders.
* Increase Product Marketing's strategic maturity and influence across the organization.
* Build a culture that combines strategic thinking, customer obsession, high standards and a strong bias for execution.

**Functional KPIs**

* Establish a clear Product Marketing strategy and operating model across RateGain’s businesses and product portfolio.
* Sharpen positioning, messaging and value propositions across priority products and markets.
* Build a coherent portfolio narrative while maintaining strong product-level differentiation.
* Establish a scalable product launch and GTM framework across businesses.
* Elevate the quality and consistency of product storytelling across RateGain.
* Strengthen customer, market, and competitive intelligence across Product and commercial decisions.
* Build and develop a high-performing Product Marketing organization.

**Strategic KPIs**

* Increase Product Marketing’s influence on Product and business decisions across RateGain.
* Strengthen competitive positioning across priority businesses, products and markets.
* Establish a compelling and connected narrative across RateGain’s broader portfolio.
* Strengthen alignment between Product, Marketing, Sales and Customer Success across business lines.
* Improve RateGain’s ability to translate technology and product innovation into clear customer value and commercial outcomes.
* Identify opportunities for cross-portfolio positioning, adoption and growth.
* Position Product Marketing as a strategic growth partner to Product and the broader business.

**Key Competencies:**

* Deep expertise across positioning, messaging, value propositions, GTM strategy, launches, and competitive intelligence.
* Ability to operate across multiple products and businesses, creating an overarching narrative without losing individual product differentiation.
* Strong outside-in thinking and the ability to translate customer, market, and competitive insights into Product and business decisions.
* Ability to understand complex B2B technology and translate technical capabilities into compelling customer value.
* Ability to develop differentiated market narratives and shape how markets understand complex products and platforms.
* Strong understanding of how Product Marketing contributes to adoption, competitive wins, and commercial growth.
* Credibility to challenge thinking and influence Product strategy and roadmap priorities across multiple businesses.
* Ability to engage and influence senior Product, Sales, Marketing, and business leadership.
* Proven ability to build, lead, and develop high-performing Product Marketing teams.
* Able to move seamlessly between setting portfolio-level strategy and personally getting involved in positioning, customer conversations, and launch execution.
* Comfortable creating and evolving the playbook in a high-growth, entrepreneurial environment.

**Education & Work Experience**

* 14+ years of experience with significant depth in Product Marketing.
* Experience leading Product Marketing at Director, Senior Director, Head, or equivalent level.
* Strong experience across positioning, messaging, product launches, GTM strategy, competitive intelligence, and sales enablement.
* Demonstrated experience operating across a multi-product or multi-business portfolio.
* Experience translating complex technical capabilities into simple, compelling customer value.
* Experience working directly with senior Product, Sales, and executive leadership.
* Experience operating across multiple customer segments, markets, and geographies.
* Strong people leadership experience, ideally managing teams of 10+.
* Experience in high-growth, entrepreneurial, or transformation environments.
* Experience in global B2B SaaS, technology, data, commerce, platform, or other complex technology ecosystems would be highly relevant.
* Travel and hospitality technology experience would be an advantage.

We are hiring an original thinker who sees patterns in things most miss and in parallel has equivalent passion to build a name for themselves in the social media industry.

We work with Meta, Google, Netflix, Microsoft, Nvidia, Indian Navy, Adobe, World Bank and brands you have definitely heard of.

* You are exceptionally fast and have high agency. You run experiments rather than waiting for permission.
* You care about real outcomes: inbound interest, registrations, and genuine community engagement.
* You treat content like it’s real estate. Every word you write has a clear value proposition and an obvious call to action.

* ROI / ROAS on campaigns

* Budget efficiency and scaling performance
* Growth in revenue, traffic, and brand visibility

title: Creator & Content Marketing Intern
description:
You’ll work inside our campaign team on live campaigns for global artists, labels, film studios and our own brands, with a focus on creator marketing. This means real responsibility on live campaigns including market research, ideation, creator identification, outreach and comms, briefing and reporting.
 



  





 We’re a small team, which means your voice is heard, your ideas will be in front of major clients, and you’ll have real accountability from early on. The role suits someone who thrives in a fast\-paced environment, learns quickly and wants to apply themselves fully.
 



  





 What you’ll be doing:
 


* Delivering creator campaigns day\-to\-day: campaign ideation, outreach, briefing, and managing creator relationships as campaigns run.
* Contributing to broader campaign strategy both internally and in client settings.
* Flagging emerging formats, rising creators and platform shifts before they’re obvious.
* Provide day\-to\-day social media support, consulting on creative, copy, and overall positioning.
* Design interactive decks for pitches, internal communication, and client presentations.
* Brief the production team on creative requirements, ensuring marketing objectives are met while maintaining cutting\-edge creative execution.
* Produce adhoc video, still, and graphic assets using Adobe Suite as needed.



  
 



 What we’re looking for:
 


* Deep fluency in the social landscape. You know the creator landscape inside out, you clock formats as they emerge, and you’re curious about the psychology of why things work, why one video travels and another doesn’t.
* A tasteful creative eye, whilst our campaigns need to drive results they also need to maintain the highest level of creative integrity for our clients.
* Sharp, clear writing ability without an overreliance on AI.
* Commitment when campaigns are live. Delivery weeks are fast and demanding including the weekends, and we want someone who enjoys that pace.



  
 



 What matters more than your CV:
 


* Show us your taste. Send us three pieces of creator content you think are brilliant and two sentences on each about why they work. We care about whether you can see what’s good before everyone else agrees.
* Share how you currently engage with socials on any personal or side\-projects: a page you run, edits you make, a deep knowledge of a corner of the internet, anything that shows this is how you already spend your time.

title: Social Media and Operations Intern
description:
**Company Description** 
 DKD Capital is an independent equity research platform focused on identifying emerging businesses at pivotal stages in their growth journey. The firm applies a structured four\-step framework—Discover, Analyse, Time, and Compound—to build and maintain robust, evidence\-based research theses. Its approach combines Growth at a Reasonable Price (GARP) with disciplined technical validation, emphasizing fundamentals, valuation, and price–volume behavior. DKD Capital’s research centers on small and microcap businesses, stage 2 growth opportunities, and continuous coverage through earnings updates and sector insights. The platform is led by SEBI Registered Research Analyst Divya Khurana Dewan, with a strong focus on analytical rigor, transparency, and responsible investor communication in line with applicable regulations.
 



  





**The role** 




 You'll own our social media presence and support day\-to\-day operations. That means building our LinkedIn page from scratch, planning what we publish across platforms, and helping us respond to the people who reach out. Your work will be visible publicly from week one.
 



**Responsibilities — social media and content** 



* Build and grow our LinkedIn company page from the ground up: positioning, page setup, content calendar and audience growth
* Develop a content strategy across Instagram, LinkedIn and Facebook, deciding what format belongs where and why
* Plan and coordinate reels: ideation, scripting support, shoot coordination, editing or working with an editor, captions and hashtags
* Design carousels and static posts in our brand style
* Plan the blog and insights calendar for our website, and coordinate with our research interns on topics
* Schedule posts, track performance, and report weekly on what's working
* Research what's performing well in the Indian finance content space and bring ideas to the table



**Responsibilities — operations and client support** 



* Respond to enquiries on Instagram, email and WhatsApp using approved templates, and escalate anything that needs the founder
* Maintain our lead tracker: who enquired, what they asked, what stage they're at
* Coordinate discovery calls and webinars, including scheduling, reminders and follow\-ups
* Support client onboarding: documentation, KYC coordination and payment follow\-ups
* Keep our content, lead and client records organised



**What you'll learn** 



* How a SEBI\-registered equity research firm is built and run
* Content marketing in a regulated industry, which is a genuinely rare skill
* How equity research works, from filings to published reports
* Working directly with the founder on strategy, not just execution



**Requirements** 



* Strong written English, with a clear, simple style
* A real understanding of how Instagram and LinkedIn work, including what makes content perform on each
* Comfortable with Canva or similar design tools
* Organised and reliable, since you'll be handling client\-facing communication
* Willing to learn financial concepts, even if you don't know them yet



**Good to have** 



* Video editing skills (CapCut, Premiere Rush or similar)
* Interest in or basic knowledge of the stock market
* Experience running a page, personal or professional
* Familiarity with SEO basics



**An important note about this industry** 




 We operate under SEBI's Research Analyst Regulations. Everything we publish follows strict rules: no promises of returns, no client testimonials, no stock tips, and no personalised advice. You'll never be asked to write anything that overstates what we do, and all content goes through the founder for approval before publishing. If you want to learn how to build an audience honestly in a regulated field, this is a good place to do it.
 



**Details** 



* Location: Noida, Uttar Pradesh (in\-office)
* Timings: 9:00 am to 5:00 pm
* Duration: 3 months, with the possibility of a full\-time role
* Stipend: ₹10,000 per month
* Certificate and letter of recommendation on successful completion



**How to apply** 




 Email info@divyakhurana.com with your CV.

**Performance Marketing Specialist (Ecommerce)** 




 Seventh Triangle Consulting \| Noida, Sector 142 \| Full\-time, on\-site or hybrid
 



  





**About us:** 




 Seventh Triangle is a Shopify Premier Partner martech and commerce agency led by former D2C founders. We run performance, retention, SEO/AEO, CRO and Shopify development for 40\+ D2C brands across India, the UK, US and Middle East. We work in short sprints, decide on data, and are accountable to clients for revenue, not impressions.
 



  





**The role** 




 You will own paid media strategy and execution for 4 to 5 brands. This is not a media\-buying seat. We expect you to understand unit economics, know why a brand's repeat rate matters and not just ROAS, and have a view on what the ad should say before the designer opens Figma.
 



  





**What you will do:** 



* Plan, run and scale Meta (Advantage\+, catalogue, creative testing) and Google (PMax, Shopping, Search) campaigns against CAC, contribution margin and blended MER targets
* Write creative briefs from customer and competitor insight, and work with our design, video and UGC team to ship and test them weekly
* Contribute to brand positioning and messaging for your accounts, not just the ad copy
* Own the retention layer for your accounts: email, WhatsApp and SMS flows, segmentation, and lifecycle campaigns on Klaviyo, Zepic or similar
* Read GA4, Shopify analytics and ad platform data to find what is actually driving revenue, and change the plan accordingly
* Present weekly and monthly performance to clients, defend the numbers, and recommend the next move
* Coordinate with our Tech, CRO, Design and SEO teams so campaigns land on pages that convert



  





**What this role is not:** 



* A reporting role where someone else decides the strategy
* A pure CRM or lifecycle role with no paid media
* Lead generation, B2B or SaaS marketing



  





**You have:** 



* 3\+ years running Meta and Google Ads for ecommerce brands, ideally in an agency handling multiple accounts
* Hands\-on experience with Shopify and at least one retention tool (Klaviyo, Zepic, WebEngage, MoEngage, Interakt or WATI)
* Working knowledge of D2C economics: CAC, LTV, contribution margin, repeat rate
* A track record of briefing creative, not just running what you were given
* Comfort presenting to founders and marketing heads
* GA4 and spreadsheet fluency; attribution tool experience is a plus

title: Vice President of Growth
description:
Neocambrian AI is building the data infrastructure for physical AI. We design and operate capture systems that turn real\-world human activity into model\-usable physical experience for leading robotics companies and frontier AI labs.
 



  





 Our ability to scale depends on access to the physical world.
 



  





 We are hiring a
 **Network Growth Lead** 
 to build the industrial network through which our hardware and operators enter factories, warehouses, workshops, and other real\-world environments across India.
 



 You will create access, convert relationships into live collection operations, and help establish Neocambrian as a visible and trusted company across industrial India.
 



  





 You may spend one morning making the commercial case to a factory owner and the afternoon working with a plant supervisor and our operations team to resolve the practical details required to launch collection on the floor.
 



  





 You will own the relationship from the first introduction to signed access, site readiness, launch, and a partnership that expands over time.
 



  




 What you will own
 * **Factory access across India:** 
 Build and manage a qualified network of manufacturing and industrial partners, with density in the clusters, industries, and task environments that matter most.
* **Partnership conversion:** 
 Own the complete journey from first contact and commercial agreement through site assessment, operational readiness, launch, and handoff into productive collection.
* **Cluster expansion:** 
 Map the industrial landscape, identify the right associations and connectors, and determine where Neocambrian should build depth rather than scatter its efforts.
* **Operational scale:** 
 Work closely with the operations team to ensure that factory access turns into reliable, repeatable data collection—not partnerships that exist only on paper.
* **A repeatable growth system:** 
 Build partner playbooks, onboarding standards, objection\-handling processes, reference loops, pipeline discipline, and reporting systems that make every new site easier to open than the last.
* **Visibility and reputation:** 
 Build Neocambrian’s presence across industrial associations, owner networks, ecosystem partners, events, and relevant public channels. Help turn our work in the field into credible stories, case studies, and partnerships that attract the next opportunity.
* **Market intelligence:** 
 Develop a clear understanding of what manufacturers care about, what prevents them from granting access, and what Neocambrian can offer that makes a long\-term partnership valuable to them.



  




 Who you are
 * You have approximately
 **5–7 years of experience** 
 building supply\-side networks, partner channels, industrial business development, distributed operations, or B2B relationships where physical access and trust matter.
* You have spent meaningful time in factories, warehouses, workshops, logistics networks, or other industrial environments. You understand that access in this world is rarely won through a cold email alone.
* You can build trust with a factory owner, communicate effectively with a plant director, and work practically with a supervisor or operator on the floor.
* You are commercially sharp but operationally grounded. You do not consider the job complete when an agreement is signed; you stay close until the site is live and productive.
* You can manage a large number of relationships and moving parts without losing attention to detail.
* You are comfortable with frequent travel across India and prefer being in the field to managing the entire function from a desk.
* You think like a dealmaker, operate like a programme owner, and want your work measured in sites opened, production enabled, and reputation compounded.



  




 What helps
 
 Experience in manufacturing, industrial services, logistics infrastructure, supply networks, B2B partnerships, field operations, or marketplace supply will be particularly valuable.
 



 Existing relationships with factory owners, industrial associations, cluster bodies, or manufacturing ecosystem partners are a strong advantage, but not a requirement.
 



  




 Location and working model
 
**Location:** 
 Noida, Uttar Pradesh
 



**Employment:** 
 Full\-time and on\-site
 



**Travel:** 
 Frequent travel across India
 



**Start date:** 
 Immediate
 



  





 Apply through LinkedIn or send a short note and CV to
 **careers@neocambrian.ai** 
 .
 



 In your note, tell us about a physical network you have built, and how you turned relationships into repeatable operations.

title: Performance Marketing Specialist (D2C)
description:
**About us:** 




 Seventh Triangle is a Shopify Premier Partner martech and commerce agency led by former D2C founders. We run performance, retention, SEO/AEO, CRO and Shopify development for 40\+ D2C brands across India, the UK, US and Middle East. We work in short sprints, decide on data, and are accountable to clients for revenue, not impressions.
 



  





**The role:** 




 You will own paid media and retention for 4 to 5 Indian D2C brands, with monthly budgets from ₹5L to ₹50L per account. This is not a media\-buying seat. We expect you to understand unit economics, know why a brand's repeat rate matters and not just ROAS, and have a view on what the ad should say before the designer comes up with the first draft. You report to a Senior Marketing Manager and join client calls from week three.
 



  





**What you will do:** 



* Plan, run and scale Meta (Advantage\+, catalogue, creative testing) and Google (PMax, Shopping, Search) campaigns against CAC, contribution margin.
* Own the retention layer for your accounts: Email and WhatsApp flows, segmentation, and lifecycle campaigns on Klaviyo, Zepic or similar.
* Write creative briefs from customer and competitor insight, and work with our design, video and UGC team to ship and test them weekly.
* Contribute to brand positioning and messaging for your accounts, not just the ad copy
* Read GA4, Shopify analytics and ad platform data to find what is actually driving revenue, and change the plan accordingly
* Present weekly and monthly performance to clients, present the numbers, and recommend next moves.
* Coordinate with our Tech, CRO, Design and SEO teams so campaigns land on pages that convert.



  





**What good looks like at 90 days:** 




 You are running your accounts without hand\-holding, clients trust your numbers, at least one retention flow you built is producing measurable repeat revenue, and creative you briefed is beating the brand's previous best.
 



  





**What this role is not:** 



* A reporting role where someone else decides the strategy
* A pure CRM or lifecycle role with no paid media
* Lead generation, B2B or SaaS marketing



  





**You should have:** 



* 3\+ years running Meta and Google Ads for D2C or ecommerce brands, ideally in an agency handling multiple accounts
* Hands\-on experience with Shopify and at least one retention tool (Klaviyo, Zepic, WebEngage, MoEngage, Interakt or WATI)
* Working knowledge of D2C economics: CAC, LTV, contribution margin, repeat rate
* A track record of briefing creative, not just running what you were given
* Comfort presenting to founders and marketing heads
* GA4 and spreadsheet fluency; attribution tool experience is a plus



  





**Why here:** 




 You learn D2C from people who have built and sold D2C. You see 4 to 5 categories at once instead of one brand for three years. Your work is measured in client revenue, and so is your growth here.
